<@&1424461167883194418> Model updates — 2026-10-14

### 🆕 New
- 🧠 **Gemini 4 Argon** (Google) — image, audio and video input; tools and search
- 🧠 **Muse Wonder 1.0** (Meta) — image input, reasoning and tools
- 🧠 **Claude Haiku 5.5** (Anthropic) — image input, reasoning and tools
- 🧠 **GPT-6 Luna Decisions** (OpenAI) — typed decisions with probabilities
- 🎨 **Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo** (Qwen) — generation and editing
- 🎬 **Kandinsky 6.0 Lite** (Kandinsky Lab) — five-second video with audio
- 🔊 **MAI Transcribe 2** (Microsoft) — audio-to-text transcription
- 🔊 **MAI-Voice-2.1** (Microsoft) — text-to-speech
- 🔊 **Qwen-Audio 3.0 TTS Flash** (Qwen) — instruction-directed speech

### 🗑️ Removed
- `qwen/qwen3-tts-instruct-flash` (audio)
- `community/pegalink/embedding-gemma-300m` (embeddings)
- `community/vendouple/anima` (image)

### ⬇️ Price cuts
- 🧠 Text: Qwen3.8 27B (~45%) · GPT-5.6 Sol (~35%) · Gemini 3.8 Flash (~5%)
- 🎨 Image: Nano Banana Pro (~5%)

### ⬆️ Price increases
- 🎨 Image: FLUX.3 Image (+100%)
- 🧠 Text: Grok 4.7 (~20%) · Qwen3 VL 30B (~15%)
- 🔊 Audio: ElevenLabs v4 and v4 Turbo (~265%) · Kokoro 82M (~60%)

### 🔒 Going paid-only
- Ling 3.1 Flash · Kev 4B · Jev · DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
- Command A+ · Nova 2 Lite · Nova Micro
- `community/AkshayCoder48/free-voice` · `community/vendouple/uncensored-image-v2`
- AssemblyAI Universal-2 and Universal-3.5 Pro

### ✨ Capability updates
- `microsoft/mai-image-2.6` and `microsoft/mai-image-2.6-flash` — up to five reference images, previously one
- `x-ai/grok-imagine-image` — up to five reference images, previously one

Explore at https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs
